title: Error bounds for splitting methods in unitary problems
summary: Splitting methods constitute a widely used class of numerical integrators for ordinary and partial differential equations, particularly well suited to problems that can be decomposed into simpler subproblems. High-order splitting schemes are available that achieve high accuracy while preserving key qualitative properties of the underlying dynamical system, and are successfully used across a broad range of fields.
